title: Mailbox/query and EmailSubmission/query silently coerce invalid limit
description: Pass 6 fixed Email/query to reject non-u64 limit with invalidArguments. Mailbox/query (args.get("limit").and_then(|v| v.as_u64())) and EmailSubmission/query (v.as_u64() in match arm) still silently treat invalid limit as None/no-limit. Inconsistency: same request pattern gets invalidArguments from Email/query but silent success from Mailbox/query.
